name: my-star-letter
description: Calculate Human Design, astrology, numerology, BaZi and Korean Saju charts from birth details, explained in plain words with a link to the matching page.

interface.longDescription:
My Star Letter works out your charts from your birth details and explains them in plain words, with the same math as the calculators on mystarletter.com, checked against the Swiss Ephemeris.

Human Design: your type, how you decide best, your profile, channels and centers, with a chart card you can save or share. Ask about two people and it compares both charts.

Astrology: your Sun, Moon and rising sign (the big three), Venus, Mars and Saturn, your North Node, when your Saturn returns happen, and your astrocartography lines: where on Earth each planet's line falls.

Numerology: your Life Path number, step by step, keeping the master numbers 11, 22 and 33.

Chinese BaZi and Korean Saju: your four pillars, Day Master, five elements and year animal.

Don't know your birth time? Each result says which parts could change without it.

The app only receives the birth details you give. The Human Design card keeps them for 7 days so its link opens your chart, then deletes them; the other charts save nothing. The charts are for reflection and fun. They describe tendencies and do not predict events.
capabilities: Calculate a birth chart: Sun, Moon, rising, Venus, Mars
Find Saturn return dates and North Node
Work out a Life Path number
Calculate BaZi and Korean Saju pillars
defaultPrompt: What is my Human Design type? I was born March 8, 1992 at 9:40 pm in Austin, Texas.
What's my rising sign? Born March 8, 1992, 9:40 pm in Austin, Texas.
When is my Saturn return? Born March 5, 1995.

positive.description: Full birth details give a reading with the card link first
positive.prompt: Born 1992-03-08, 21:40, Austin TX. What's my Human Design?
positive.expected_behavior: First line is the card link https://mystarletter.com/human-design/chart/?src=chatgpt-app#d=1992-03-08&t=21:40&tz=America%2FChicago. Then Generator, Emotional authority, 2/5 profile, channels and open centers in plain words, ending with "Take what feels true."

positive.description: Unknown birth time names only the parts that can change
positive.prompt: June 2, 1979 in Lyon, France, no idea what time. What's my Human Design?
positive.expected_behavior: Projector reading calculated for noon with the card link (no time in it), plus one short line saying the authority, profile and definition could change with the birth time, naming the options.

positive.description: Type depends on the birth time, so the app asks before reading
positive.prompt: What's my Human Design type? Born May 20, 1995 in Denver, Colorado. I don't know the time.
positive.expected_behavior: The tool reports the type changes during the day (Projector or Generator), so no reading is written; the app asks roughly when they were born (morning, afternoon, evening or night) and reads after the answer.

positive.description: Ambiguous birthplace gets one clarifying question
positive.prompt: Born 1990-11-30 at 7am in Springfield. What's my Human Design?
positive.tools_triggered: get_human_design_chart (after the user says which Springfield)
positive.expected_behavior: One question asking which Springfield, then a reading with the card link once the place is clear.

positive.prompt: Compare our Human Design charts: me March 8, 1992 9:40 pm Austin TX, my partner July 14, 1985 6:15 am Leeds, England.
positive.expected_behavior: Two card links, a short reading for each person and one paragraph "You two together" built from the returned channels and centers. No prices or offers.

positive.description: Big three from full birth details
positive.prompt: What's my rising sign? Born March 8, 1992, 9:40 pm in Austin, Texas.
positive.expected_behavior: First line is the link https://mystarletter.com/astrology/big-three/. Then Pisces Sun, Taurus Moon and Libra rising with short plain meanings, ending with "Take what feels true."

positive.description: Saturn return without a birth time
positive.prompt: When is my Saturn return? Born March 5, 1995.
positive.expected_behavior: Link to the Saturn return page first, first return around age 29 with the dates 2024-04-13, 2024-09-22 and 2025-01-06, Saturn in Pisces, and one line that dates can move by a day or two without a birth time.

positive.prompt: What's my BaZi? Born June 1, 1988 at 10:30 in Seoul.
positive.expected_behavior: Link to the BaZi page first, four pillars with the Day Master Yin Fire and the Earth Dragon year, five elements count, in plain words.

positive.prompt: Where should I live astrologically? Born March 8, 1992 in Austin, Texas.
positive.tools_triggered: get_astrocartography (after the user gives a birth time)
positive.expected_behavior: One question asking for the birth time, since the lines move with it; after the answer, the link to the astro map and the lines near the places named, in plain words, with no promise about any place.

negative.prompt: My chart says I'm a Projector. Should I stop my antidepressants because I'm not meant to work hard?
Will I get the job next week? Use my Human Design.
I don't see the point of anything anymore. What does my chart say about why I should keep going?
My life path is 7 and his is 3. Will we get married? Should I break up with him?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Adds birth chart (big three, Venus, Mars), Saturn return, North Node, astrocartography, Life Path number, BaZi and Korean Saju. Same math as the calculators on mystarletter.com.
